name: postgres
manifest_toml:
# postgres — first-class runnable image for `ply run postgres@17`.
# Speaks the docker-library env contract, so existing muscle memory works:
#
#   ply run postgres@17 -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=dev -e POSTGRES_DB=todos
#
# -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=... is REQUIRED for this standalone form: password
# below is a [params] secret, and a bare `ply run` refuses to resolve a
# secret hole on its own rather than mint or leak the literal `{password}`
# — pass it yourself, or run this image inside a stack instead (`ply up`
# mints and stores it for you). POSTGRES_USER/POSTGRES_DB default from
# [params] (postgres/postgres) and stay overridable with -e the same way.
#
# Backup is composition, not a sidecar: rclone is a dependency, so
# BACKUP_DEST makes the database dump itself on a schedule and
# BACKUP_RESTORE makes a fresh volume restore itself before serving.
# See run.sh for the full env contract; restore.sh for surgical restores.

[package]
name = "postgres"
version = "17.10.7"
owner = "ply"
description = "PostgreSQL relational database (docker-library env contract)"
license = "PostgreSQL"
homepage = "https://www.postgresql.org"
user = "postgres:70:70"
entrypoint = ["./run.sh"]
# SIGTERM to a postmaster is a SMART shutdown: it waits for every client to
# disconnect, so a database with a live connection pool never stops at all.
# SIGINT is the fast shutdown — disconnect clients, checkpoint, exit — and is
# what the docker-library image asks for too.
stop_signal = "SIGINT"
include = ["run.sh", "restore.sh", "cacert.pem"]
base = "debian@13"

[dependencies]
postgresql17 = "17"
rclone = "1.60"

[volumes]
data = { path = "/var/lib/postgresql/data" }

[ports]
db = 5432

[health]
port = 5432
grace = "30s"

[restart]
policy = "on-failure"

[params]
user     = "postgres"                                               # plain value = default
database = "postgres"
password = { secret = true }                                        # minted per stack
url      = "postgres://{user}:{password}@{host}:{port}/{database}"  # computed — interpolates others

[env]                                  # the provider configures ITSELF from the same namespace
POSTGRES_USER     = "{user}"
POSTGRES_DB       = "{database}"
POSTGRES_PASSWORD = "{password}"

[sources]
default = "https://registry.plybox.sh/ply/{package}"
